g.text: Ariel System — Multi-AZ High Availability, Resilience & Horizontal Scaling Topology
Multi-AZ Production Kubernetes Cluster (99.99%+ Availability SLA)
Elastic Horizontal Autoscaling Control Plane (Kubernetes HPA + KEDA)
Health-Checked Cross-Zone Traffic Distribution + TLS 1.3 Termination
Scales Stateless API Pods (3 -> 100+ Replicas across AZs)
Triggers: CPU > 70%, Memory, Prometheus RPS & P99 Latency
Scales Stream Processor Pods (3 -> 64 Replicas across AZs)
Trigger: Apache Kafka Consumer Group Lag > 5,000 msgs/partition
